articles.headline: Google plans €13 billion Finland infrastructure investment for 2027-2028
articles.summary: Google (NASDAQ:GOOG) plans to invest at least €13 billion in digital infrastructure in Finland during 2027 and 2028, covering data centres and related infrastructure across four locations. The company said the investment, its largest single investment in Europe, will include facilities in Hamina, Kajaani, Muhos and Vaala and will provide infrastructure for services including Gemini, Search, Maps and YouTube.
